::: {#lem-rss-deriv-slope}
#### Derivative of RSS with respect to the slope

The partial derivative of the simple linear regression
residual sum of squares $\text{RSS}(\intcoef, \coef{x})$ (@exm-rss-slr)
with respect to the slope is

$$\frac{\partial \text{RSS}}{\partial \coef{x}}
= -2 \sumin x_i (\outvar_\iobs - \intcoef - \coef{x} x_i).$$
:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-rss-deriv-slope.

:::
